notes.title: Fixed (Ver 1.3.3)
notes.content: * Fixed a minor bug.

notes.title: Changed server (Ver 1.3.2)
notes.content:
* The server you are connecting to has been changed.

* Improved synchronization method.

# Please note that we will not be able to match players with different versions of the game.

notes.title: Friend matching (Ver 1.3.0)
notes.content:
* Added the feature to set a keyword for friend matching from the settings screen so that you can only match with people who have set the same keyword.
# By leaving the keywords blank, you can still do quick matching as before.

# The game will not match players with different versions.

notes.title: Fixed (Ver 1.2.3)
notes.content:
* Fixed an issue where during online multiplayer, if you select the same stage as the current stage on the stage selection screen when the game is over or after the game is cleared, the other players will not be displayed.

# The game will not match players with different versions.

notes.title: Server Upgraded
notes.content:
The client update is now release due to the server upgrade.
This is a data-only update, so there is no change to the version notation.

If you are unable to connect to the game, please try quitting the game and restarting Steam.
The game will be updated automatically.

notes.title: Ver 1.2.2 redistributed
notes.content: The previous version 1.2.2 was not distributed properly, so we have re-distributed it.

notes.title: Improvement (Version 1.2.2)
notes.content:
* Increased the maximum number of players to 10.
# In the latest version (1.2.2), the maximum number of players will be 10 when starting a new stage with no one present.

notes.title: Improved and Fixed (Ver 1.2.1)
notes.content:
[b]*Please note that you cannot be matched with players of different versions[/b].

* Easter eggs have been added to the title menu.

* The brightness setting range has been expanded.

* The brightness of Stage 5 has been slightly darkened.

* Adjusted the hit detection of the vertical rotation board again.

* Increased the maximum number of players to 9.
# In the latest version (1.2.1), the maximum number of players will be 9 when starting a new stage with no one present.

* Other minor bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: New feature added (Ver 1.2.0)
notes.content:
[b]The structure of the player data has been changed in this update, so players with different versions cannot be matched.[/b]

* Metallic egg avatar will be released after goal all stages including extra stage.

* Crown icon will appear in the player list after goal all stages including extra stage.

* Star icon will appear in the player list after goal all 5 stages including extra stage.

notes.title: Improved and fixed (Ver 1.1.7)
notes.content:
* The brake force that takes into account the position correction process has been applied.

* The window size in windowed mode is now remembered.

* Fixed a problem in which the resolution did not match the full screen resolution once the window mode was set.

notes.title: Improved (Ver 1.1.6)
notes.content:
* Countermeasures against processing failures during offline play

* Improved the accuracy of judging hits on vertically rotating boards.

* To reduce the load, the dead eggs of other players are deleted after 10 minutes.

* Other load reduction measures

notes.title: Improved and Fixed (Ver 1.1.5)
notes.content:
* Improved rendering process.

* Improved the accuracy of ground detection.

* Fixed an issue where another stage would start on retry under certain conditions.

notes.title: Fixed (Ver 1.1.4)
notes.content:
* Fixed a rare issue where players could slip through a vertically rotating wooden board during online play.

* Fixed an issue where the volume would sometimes change on its own.

notes.title: Increase in the number of players and fix (Ver. 1.1.3)
notes.content:
* The maximum number of players has been increased to 8.
# In the latest version (1.1.3), if you start a new stage with no one in it, the maximum number of players will be 8.

* Fixed a problem where the floor would fall out in Stage 5.

notes.title: Improved operability (Ver 1.1.2)
notes.content: If you are using a gamepad, you will not be able to move the viewpoint until you set the right-stick to neutral once you select a emoji.

notes.title: Fixed（Ver 1.1.1）
notes.content:
* Fixed an issue where the stamina gauge would sometimes be consumed faster than usual when braking.

* Fixed other minor bugs.

notes.title: Extreme difficulty stage added (Ver 1.1.0)
notes.content:
* Extra stage added for extreme difficulty.
# Please play at your own pace and do not overdo it.

* The maximum number of players has been increased to 7.
# In the latest version (1.1.0), when you start a new stage with no one in it, the maximum number of players will be 7.

* Fixed a problem in Stage 6 that allowed players to climb in places where they shouldn't be able to.

notes.title: Window mode and fixes (Ver 1.0.10)
notes.content:
* Added window mode switching by setting.

* Fixed a problem in Stage 6 that allowed you to climb in places that were not supposed to be climbable.

* Fixed other minor bugs.

notes.title: Improvements and fixes（Ver 1.0.9）
notes.content:
* Due to the isolation of players (eggs) outside of Japan, we now have a single server to connect to.

* The maximum number of players has been increased to 6.
#In the latest version (1.0.9), when you start a new stage with no one in it, the maximum number of players will be 6.

* Fixed a problem with the image when selecting an emoji.

* The texture of the wood in Stage 4 has been fixed.

notes.title: Improvements and fixes（Ver 1.0.8）
notes.content:
The following actions have been taken.

* Increased the maximum number of simultaneous players to 5.
#The maximum number of players will be 5 when starting a new stage with no one in version 1.0.8.

* Fixed a bug that caused eggs to continue to exist when they shouldn't.

notes.title: Online Multiplayer Resumed (Ver 1.0.7)
notes.content:
The online multiplayer feature has been restarted.

Please update to the latest version and select online in the settings.
You can now play in online mode.

The maximum number of players has been changed to 4 due to server load measures.
#The number of players may be increased in the future depending on server load.

notes.title: Fixed（Ver 1.0.6）
notes.content:
#Still working on the online multiplay issue. Please wait for a while.

The following bugs have been fixed.

* Fixed a problem where the toast could not be taked in stage 2.
* Fixed a problem in Stage 6 where you could pass through places you normally couldn't.
* Fixed an issue where the mouse cursor would not be displayed while paused.

notes.title: About Online Multimode
notes.content:
We are currently experiencing some inconveniences in terms of communication, and as it is difficult to respond immediately, we are temporarily suspending the online mode.

We expect to be able to resume online mode in the near future.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause, and ask that you please wait for a while until the game resumes.

notes.title: Optimized network traffic and fixed bugs (Ver. 1.0.4)
notes.content:
The followings have been taken.

* Optimized network traffic volume.

* Fixed a problem that allowed users to climb in places where they could not normally climb.

notes.title: Optimized network traffic Part 2（Ver 1.0.3）
notes.content: Further optimization of network traffic volume has been done.

notes.title: Optimized network traffic（Ver 1.0.2）
notes.content:
The following actions have been taken.

* Optimized the network traffic volume.

* Correction of error messages.

notes.title: Fixed server issues（Ver 1.0.1）
notes.content:
Fixed the problem of not being able to connect to the server.
Please update to Version 1.0.1 and try again.

notes.title: Unable to connect to the server.
notes.content:
We have confirmed that there is a problem with the online mode that prevents you from connecting to the server.

We are working on a fix for this issue, so please wait for a while until it is completed.

Please note that offline mode is still playable.
